title: Aphid croaks stolen Echos Frozen keckles Kissing spokes Of repeated beauty. #smallpoems
summary: Aphid croaks stolen Echos Frozen keckles Kissing spokes Of repeated beauty. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Aphid croaks
stolen
Echos
Frozen keckles
Kissing spokes
Of repeated beauty.
#smallpoems
